title: Hand Off a Conditional Ready
subtitle: The manager acknowledges the caveat
scenario: The package is ready with a loaner. Hand it to the hiring manager - but this time readiness is conditional, and the manager must acknowledge the caveat, not just a clean bill. Capture that they saw the loaner exception and still confirmed the hire can start.
input: The degraded Day-One Package for hire H-4022 is ready: the hire starts on a loaner while the ordered laptop ships. Deliver it to the Hiring Manager and capture a CONDITIONAL acknowledgement - they saw the caveat (loaner) and confirmed the start proceeds.
instructions: Set readyConfirmed to conditional (ready with a caveat).
Confirm the caveat (the loaner) was noted.
Validate to mint the acknowledgement record.

fields.label: Acknowledged by
fields.explain: The hiring manager owns the first day and must acknowledge the package, caveat and all.

fields.label: Ready confirmed
fields.explain: Readiness is conditional on the loaner; recording a clean 'yes' would hide the exception the manager needs to know.

fields.label: Caveat noted
fields.explain: The manager must have seen the loaner caveat; an acknowledgement that skips the exception is not informed consent.

copilotPrompt: Capture a conditional manager handoff: acknowledged by the Hiring Manager, readyConfirmed conditional (loaner caveat), caveatNoted yes. The manager saw the exception and confirmed the start.
successMessage: Conditional handoff captured. The manager acknowledged the caveat and confirmed the start.

sections.title: A caveat is not a footnote
sections.body: When readiness is conditional, the acknowledgement must reflect that. A clean 'yes' on a degraded package sets the manager up to be blindsided when the loaner needs returning.

sections.title: Conditional is a real answer
sections.body: Recording 'conditional' is honest: the hire can start, on a loaner. It transfers ownership with the exception attached, not buried.

sections.title: Consent must be informed
sections.body: caveatNoted confirms the manager actually saw the exception. That is the difference between a rubber stamp and an accountable receipt.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A conditional acknowledgement record that carries the caveat into the archive.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd tell the manager 'ready, but on a loaner' and get a clear 'understood, proceed' before closing it out.

an approval card carrying the package summary; the reply is captured on the run

takeaway.heading: Conditional handoff captured
points: You captured a conditional acknowledgement, not a clean yes.
The manager confirmed the start while seeing the loaner caveat.
caveatNoted proves the acknowledgement was informed.
The exception travels with the handoff into the archive.
The workflow can now hand off a degraded hire with informed consent.
